verdict.rationale: OpenAI publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec for its REST API (openai-openapi repo) and a full API reference with runnable code samples, which underlies Codex's API-key usage mode, but no evidence ties a dedicated OpenAPI spec specifically to the Codex agent/CLI's own endpoints or config surface. Missing for 10: a Codex-specific machine-readable spec (vs. the general OpenAI platform API spec), and any documentation explicitly pointing Codex users to download/use this spec for their workflows.
